findingDetails.title: The no-brief fallback is read as a routing head, so a command named in the directive block gains a document line after the directives
findingDetails.claim: withCommandDocuments treats a context that starts with the directive separator as a head, so a fallback whose directive block names a command gains a Command documents line after the directives.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked the handler fallback shape and the sibling reduceRepeatedHead label branch; both confirm the leading-newline fallback is a real input.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The separator at index 0 could be read as a malformed brief rather than a head; either way the function must not append a document line for a command nobody offered.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: None; the line is truthful and only adds text after the directives.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The Vibe part is in the declared vibe-hooks-doctor scope; withCommandDocuments is its only document-line producer and the fallback shape is produced by the in-scope handler.

findingDetails.title: The subagent guard keys on a field no Vibe source or test names, while the hook contract promises a subagent turn gets no brief
findingDetails.claim: isChildSession reads payload.parent_session_id as the subagent marker, but no in-repo Vibe payload schema or test names that key, so the contract promise is unverified.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the repository for parent_session_id and for a Vibe pre_agent schema; the only hits are spec metadata, not a Vibe payload contract.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Vibe may send parent_session_id on subagent turns; the gap is that nothing in the repository proves it and no test pins it.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Unchanged; the missing evidence is the finding.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both the part and the hook contract are in the declared scope; the child marker is a behavior the contract states.

spec_code.notes: Phase 030 REQ-006 is contradicted for a fallback whose directive block names a command; REQ-007 cases hold.

checklist_evidence.notes: AC-006 and AC-007 are Met; neither covers the no-brief fallback.

skill_agent.notes: No agent definition changed in this area.

agent_cross_runtime.notes: The part is runtime-neutral; live proof belongs to the manual playbook.

noveltyJustification: Both findings are new: the fallback-shape scan has no suite case, and the subagent key has no schema or test.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Twelve changed source, test and doc files across the Vibe hook, the doctor checks and the CI workflow.

targetSelection.selectionReason: The correctness iteration follows the new Vibe part and the composer and handler that feed it.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The document line can be produced for a context that has no routing head.
searchLedger.invariant: Only a head that names a command gains a document line, before the directive block.

searchActions.result: separator > 0 treats an index-0 separator as no separator.
Returned the fallback plus a Command documents line.

searchLedger.rationale: The handler returns exactly that fallback shape when no brief exists.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The subagent guard reads a field the host does not send.
searchLedger.invariant: A subagent turn receives no brief.

searchActions.result: No Vibe payload schema or test names the field.

searchLedger.rationale: The contract states the behavior and only the untested key implements it.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A repeated head is delivered twice.

searchActions.result: Reads the receipt, compares, writes only on change.
Second call returns an empty string.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Equal head suppressed by the receipt comparison and pinned by the suite.
